description:
[NicheDB] A phone number, with its country code (+1 202 555 0143; ten digits are read as North American). Answers `number` (valid, country, national and international format, line type where the country publishes it), and for North America `areaCode`, `exchange`, `block` and `carrier` (the carrier the block was ASSIGNED to by NANPA, with a landline/wireless/voip guess from its name; ports are not public), `reports.fcc` (unwanted-call complaints naming it as caller or call-back number: count, types, recent) and `reports.sms` (the smshub.dev SMS blacklist), and `businesses` that publish it. Never the owner of a personal line.

Served by NicheDB (https://nichedb.dev/docs/mcp).

number.description: A phone number with country code, e.g. +1 202 555 0143
